messages:
Mira: Heads up — eu-agg backfill (id=98321) got preempted by quota and left ~120 shards in limbo. Can we do a fast rescue flow? :eyes:
OpsBot: [automated] backfill 98321 preempted by quota-exhaustion at 2026-03-20T17:12:08Z. Preempted_shards=118.
Mira: Ideally a UI button to grant a very short-lived priority so those shards can finish (5-10m). No full escalation.
Jon: Prefer not to add global priority toggles. What about issuing ephemeral "rescue tokens" that give extra slot weighting limited by TTL and shard count?
Samir: Token sounds safer if we scope it: per-backfill, per-region, TTL, and auditable. We can also cap total rescue concurrency.
Elaine: We'll need an internal API so operator scripts and the console can call it. Proposal: POST /internal/backfills/{id}/rescue with {token_ttl_seconds, reason, dry_run}.
Jon: We already have /recompute endpoints that are overloaded for many modes. I think a focused route is cleaner: /internal/backfills/{id}/rescue. Keep intent explicit.
Mira: UX question — should the UI show an estimated cost/impact and block if it breaches region caps? I don't want folks accidentally nuking capacity.
Samir: Yes. Rescue tokens should not bypass region capacity caps. They should only increase per-job weighting within existing capacity.
Elaine: Also require an audit comment and optional slack notify to #eng-sre. Add a short TTL and auto-revoke.
Mira: Example API call for review:
```json
POST /internal/backfills/98321/rescue
{
  "token_ttl_seconds": 600,
  "reason": "late eu ingest - small window",
  "dry_run": false
}
```
Jon: Implementation notes: backend needs token minting, token verifier in the routing layer, console button + confirm modal, and feature flag (ff:rescue-mode).
Samir: I can prototype server changes to mint tokens and wire the routing weight. Plan: token contains (backfill_id, region, ttl, max_shards). Signed JWT-like blob.
Elaine: I'll draft the API contract and add a swagger section. Also will add to the internal changelog and require audit logs.
Mira: UX microcopy: "Rescue backfill — grants short-lived priority for stranded shards. Limited by region caps. Requires justification and is auditable."
Jon: Guardrails: 1) max TTL 900s, 2) max concurrent rescue tokens per-region = 3, 3) tokens cannot move job into burst pool.
Samir: Metrics to track: rescue_success_rate, rescue_avg_duration, rescue_cost_delta. OpsBot: [metrics] past 30d rescue attempts: 45, success_rate=0.86, avg_duration=420s.
Mira: Who can own rollout? I can do UX + console copy. Samir owns backend prototype. Elaine owns API docs. Jon will coordinate feature flag rollout with @eng-sre.
Jon: Please put small PRs — feature-flagged, test coverage for token expiry and routing checks. We should also add a canary that limits to a single tenant for the first release.
Mira: Adding checklist: confirm audit log record, confirm slack notification, update runbook for manual rescues.
Samir: I'll open a draft PR and ping this thread.
Elaine: Drafting API spec now and will link in the PR.
Mira: tagging @eng-sre — please standby for a brief two-hour window for rollout tomorrow morning.
Jon: ack.
Mira: thanks team :thumbsup:
